title: Work Addiction (Workaholism)
description:
These daily affirmations are designed to support individuals recovering from work addiction, also known as
workaholism. Recovery is a journey of restoring balance, prioritizing well-being, nurturing meaningful
relationships, and recognizing that your worth extends far beyond your productivity. These affirmations
encourage self-awareness, healthy boundaries, emotional resilience, and intentional living. They are
intended to complement professional counseling, coaching, stress management practices, and support
from trusted family, friends, or colleagues.

safety.disclaimer: This programme complements counselling, hypnotherapy, EFT, and trusted accountability. It is not a medical cure.
safety.reminder:
Meaningful work can be deeply rewarding, but true success includes physical health, emotional well-
being, rest, relationships, and personal fulfillment. If work has become a source of chronic stress,
burnout, or has begun to interfere with your relationships or quality of life, seeking support from a
mental health professional, coach, or trusted mentor can help restore balance. Recovery from work
addiction is not about caring less about your work-it is about caring more for yourself and the life
you are working so hard to build.

modules.title: Strength & Growth
focus: I work with intention rather than compulsion.
Balance allows me to perform with greater clarity and purpose.

modules.title: Freedom & Purpose
focus: My life is measured by love, purpose, health, and joy-not just productivity.
I create time for rest, recreation, and meaningful experiences.
I embrace a future built on balance, fulfillment, and lasting well-being.

activities.title: Closing affirmation and forward plan
activities.affirmation:
I am not defined by my workload, achievements, or productivity. I am defined by my character, my
values, and my ability to live with purpose and balance. Every day I choose healthy boundaries, I
strengthen my well-being, deepen my relationships, and create a life that honors both meaningful
work and meaningful living. One decision, one day, and one step at a time, I am building a life of
balance, fulfillment, freedom, and lasting peace.
